title: Build apps by voice for FREE? 🤯 Using Claude Code + N2 is a game changer!
description:
Unlock a powerful new way to code using the latest agentic technology. This walkthrough reveals how to leverage Claude Code combined with the newly released N2 API, a Qwen 3.5-based model designed specifically for complex agentic workflows and deep research. See firsthand how to set up this system to build applications using voice commands, complete with live previews and an impressive 262K context window, all without paying for API access.
#ClaudeCode #N2 #AIcoding #Programming #AgenticAI
